next.reason: 1985 GR9 (base text): with NOT INVALID KEY, control goes to imperative-statement-2 on success and also 'b. If the execution of the WRITE statement is unsuccessful for a reason other than an invalid key condition, after updating the I-O status ... and after executing the procedure, if any, specified by a USE AFTER STANDARD EXCEPTION PROCEDURE'. §2023:9.1.14, when the invalid key condition does not exist: 'If the I-O status indicates an unsuccessful completion that is not an invalid key condition', control follows the exception processing and then goes to the end of the statement; the NOT INVALID KEY statement runs only 'If the I-O status indicates a successful completion'. A relative WRITE that fails for another reason (status 44 or 48) ran imperative-statement-2 under 1985 and does not under 2023. The X3.23b-1993 Correction Amendment, item (21), made this change, so it separates base 1985 from amended 1985.
